stalls.en: Tian Yi Xiang Pork Thick Soup
stalls.where: 奠濟宮一帶，仁三路 27-1 號（另有資料記為 31 號攤）
stalls.summaryZh: 三代經營的老攤，網友最常點滷肉飯配肉羹：滷肉肥瘦均勻不膩口，肉羹湯清甜、份量足。滷肉飯是廟口網路討論度最高的品項。
stalls.summaryEn: A third-generation stall. Most people order braised pork rice with pork thick soup. Reviewers say the pork is evenly braised and not greasy, and the soup is light and generous. Braised pork rice is the most-discussed dish at Miaokou online.

sources.title: 基隆廟口夜市美食（蕃新聞旅遊，2025）
基隆廟口夜市美食推薦（GoFunIt，2026）
基隆廟口夜市小吃網路聲量 TOP10（聯合新聞網，2026）

stalls.summaryZh: 炸過的長麵包外酥帶甜，夾火腿、滷蛋、小黃瓜、番茄和美乃滋，是觀光客必朝聖的廟口代表。近年漲價不少，也有網友覺得 CP 值下降。
stalls.summaryEn: A fried, slightly sweet bun stuffed with ham, braised egg, cucumber, tomato and mayo. It is a must-stop for tourists. Prices have risen a lot in recent years, and some reviewers now feel it is poor value.

sources.title: 基隆廟口夜市美食（蕃新聞旅遊，2025）

基隆廟口夜市美食推薦（GoFunIt，2026）

stalls.en: Wu Ji Crab Thick Soup & Oily Rice
stalls.summaryZh: 多數人推薦一羹一飯一起點：羹料多、勾芡不重，油飯香、粒粒分明。2026 年春節漲到一碗 100 元，網路上有不少人嫌蟹肉偏少。
stalls.summaryEn: Most people recommend ordering the crab soup together with the oily rice. The soup is generous and lightly thickened, and the rice is fragrant with separate grains. A rise to NT$100 a bowl at Lunar New Year 2026 drew complaints about how little crab meat there is.

stalls.summaryZh: 冰打得綿密扎實、味道濃，花生花豆是人氣口味，巧克力也不會太甜；旁邊還有另一家泡泡冰，常被拿來比較。
stalls.summaryEn: Shaved ice whipped until dense and rich. Peanut with beans is the favourite, and the chocolate is not overly sweet. Another bubble-ice stall next door is often compared with it.

stalls.summaryEn: Handmade sesame tangyuan with a chewy skin, served in fragrant sweet rice wine that is not too sweet. A popular dessert after the market. You can eat in or buy frozen packs to take home.

stalls.summaryZh: 百年老店，配料多、湯頭清爽不死鹹，鼎邊趖口感Q；常有排隊人潮，但翻桌快。
stalls.summaryEn: A century-old stall. Lots of toppings in a light, not-too-salty broth with chewy rice-batter noodles. There is often a line, but tables turn over quickly.

stalls.summaryZh: 炭火烤的小香腸配生蒜，Q彈多汁，邊走邊吃很方便；也有網友反映假日人多時熟度不太穩定。
stalls.summaryEn: Small charcoal-grilled sausages eaten with raw garlic. Juicy, springy and easy to eat while walking. Some reviewers say doneness can be uneven on busy weekends.

stalls.summaryEn: A stall running for over half a century. Fish paste is fried to order, lightly crisp outside and soft and springy inside, served with sweet sauce and pickled cucumber. Popular with locals too.

stalls.summaryEn: Fresh, tender lamb without gaminess or grease — a less common lamb option inside Miaokou.

stalls.summaryEn: Cheap, refreshing traditional drinks; the cocoa milk is notably smooth.

stalls.summaryEn: Smaller, less oily and starchy omelet with a savory-spicy sauce instead of the sweet pink one, so the oysters shine.
